faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP Envy x360 15-ED, 15-EE, 15T-ED, 15M-EE, 15M-ED, 15Z-EE series and the Envy 17-CH, 17m-CH, 17-CG series, which share the same keyboard. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this version includes the backlight cable, matching the original.
